summary: Orbit (dashboard/desktop) now renders operation (Next actions for Main, Waiting on others, Blocked, idle reason, warnings, fingerprint), supervisor health, handoff and per-worker context pressure. A registered-only (ASSIGNED) worker is labelled 'registered only, not active'; a blocked task (worker BLOCKED or listed in operation.blocked) is labelled 'BLOCKED, not running'. Missing or not-computed sections render as UNAVAILABLE with a reason. Every value keeps its quality badge. Implemented and unit-tested with synthetic data, including a snapshot built by L1's snapshot.py and rendered through orbit.js. The Electron window itself is NOT TESTED; nothing OBSERVED live.
